title: exec-staff-meeting-prep-notes-2026-03-28
body:
Purpose:
- Prep notes for weekly Exec Staff / Leadership sync (Thu 9:00-10:30 PT).
- Focus: topline metrics, Dedicated ramp, Private pipeline, major risks + asks for board/ops.

Agenda draft (30/60/90):
1) Quick wins & FYI (10m) — wins since last week (hosted cost improvements; SLOs stable)
2) Metrics deep-dive (20m) — hosted API traffic + cost, Dedicated utilization, Private sales pipeline health
3) Ops & Reliability (15m) — incident runbook adoption, canary rollback case, SRE hiring choke points
4) GTM & Sales (15m) — Dedicated contracts update, top prospects for Private pilot, marketplace listing status
5) Product decisions & asks (15m) — model rollout policy changes, new quantization defaults, roadmap alignment
6) Risks / blocker round-robin (10m) — each leader 1 min
7) Action items & close (5m)

Notes / Talking points:
- Hosted API: token volume +12% w/w; 95p latency stable at 140ms. Cost per 1k tokens down 6% after batching tweak. Need to confirm weekly trend (Danielle to validate sampling window).
- Dedicated: utilization creeping up on N-gpu pool; two customers moved from sandbox to prod (ACME, NovaHealth). Planning a small burst pool for EMEA from 4/1. Confirm capacity commit and pricing templates.
- Private: three inbound RFPs this week; one LOI in negotiation (FinReg corp). Security checklist completion rate still 65% for customer onboarding — we should flag resource gap in solutions-eng.
- SLOs: small regression on error budget for long sequences (>8k) — likely kernel selection issue after recent runtime change. REPRO steps in infra ticket INFR-234. Prioritize a hotfix or rollback option.
- Observability: Console retention migration plan needs sign-off. Tradeoff: we can reduce retention for low-tier to cut storage cost but must ensure audit customers unaffected.

Risks & escalation items:
- Risk: If Dedicated utilization stays >85% for 2 weeks, we risk higher latency SLO breaches during peak. Ask: temporary burst capacity + ops on-call to monitor.
- Risk: Private onboarding is bottlenecked by security review; solutions-eng hiring lagging. Ask: allocate contractor for checklist remediation (30–60d).
- Risk: Model rollout change could affect quality for top 3 enterprise customers. Ask: hold canary longer + add regression alerts tied to eval prompt sets.

Pre-reads (short):
- Hosted weekly metrics dashboard (1 page) — see linked dashboard in GH PR/Confluence
- INFR-234: long-sequence error budget regression (blamestorm notes, repro)
- Sales summary: Dedicated & Private pipeline deck (two slides)

CEO / Chair notes (what I’ll say):
- We’re generally tracking well on hosted economics; recent infra changes gave immediate cost wins but introduced an edge-case regression for long sequences — patch plan ready.
- Dedicated demand strong; need quick capacity decision for EMEA burst to avoid losing 2 prospects.
- Private pipeline healthy but onboarding throughput must improve — propose temporary contractor and a clear SLA for security checklist turnaround.

Open questions (to resolve in meeting):
- Do we approve 2-week EMEA burst capacity (cost impact estimate attached)? (decision owner: CFO / infra lead)
- Approve contractor hire for solutions-eng (30–60d) or re-prioritize current headcount?
- Do we delay model rollout default change until after additional canary validation?

Follow-ups & action items (owners & rough due dates):
- AI-1: Danielle Kim — Validate hosted metrics sampling windows and confirm weekly trend artifacts (due 2026-03-30).
- AI-2: Marco Lopez — Capacity plan & cost estimate for EMEA burst + pricing template update (due 2026-04-01).
- AI-3: Ava Thompson — Collate Private onboarding checklist failure modes and estimate contractor scope (due 2026-03-31).
- AI-4: Priya Shah (me) — Draft proposed canary extension + regression alert config and circulate for sign-off (due 2026-03-29).
- AI-5: Infra team (INFR-234) — Root-cause and hotfix plan for long-sequence kernel regressions; update exec by 2026-03-30.
- AI-6: Sales ops — Finalize LOI terms for FinReg corp and confirm timeline for pilot (due 2026-04-05).

Quick scratchpad (things to call out live):
- Pull latest cost delta chart into the call (Danielle will share).
- If CEO pushes on speed: highlight mitigations (burst capacity, canary rollback, caching tweaks).
- Ask CFO for temporary budget for contractor if pipeline risk seems urgent.

Rough decisions I expect to push for:
- Approve EMEA burst for short window if cost delta < $X/day (TBD in meeting).
- Approve 30–60d contractor for solutions-eng to unblock Private onboarding.

Notes to self:
- Keep convo lean — focus on decisions and blockers, defer deep technicals to infra sync.
- Capture final action items in GH issues and epic tags for tracking.

AI-3: Ava Thompson — Collate Private onboarding checklist failure modes and estimate contractor scope (due 2026-03-31)
AI-4: Priya Shah — Draft proposed canary extension + regression alert config and circulate for sign-off (due 2026-03-29)
AI-5: Infra team — Root-cause and hotfix plan for long-sequence kernel regressions; update exec by 2026-03-30
